timeBasis.zh: observedAt 与 reviewedAt 是分阶段检索的已知截止。只有发布日期的材料按次日 12:00 UTC 计，链上精确时点和版本发布另按原记录。
timeBasis.en: The two timestamps are retrieval cutoffs. Date-only publications become eligible at noon UTC the next day. Precisely timed block and release evidence uses its own cutoff.

analysisBasis.zh: 假设、另一种解释与检验条件由 Astarter 根据当时已公开材料在事后整理，不代表当事人或 Agent 当时实际做出的判断。
analysisBasis.en: Astarter reconstructed the hypotheses, alternatives and tests from information available at the observation cutoff. These are not original statements or trade decisions by an actor or agent.

title: USDC 储备解冻后，赎回走通了吗？
Could USDC redemptions clear after the bank reopened?

text: Circle 披露在硅谷银行存有 33 亿美元，约占当时 USDC 储备的 8%。
Circle disclosed $3.3bn at Silicon Valley Bank, about 8% of its USDC reserves.
监管机构宣布保护存款人后，Circle 表示可在银行开门后调动这笔资金。
After regulators announced depositor protection, Circle expected to regain access when banks opened.

hypothesis: 资金可动用后，积压的法币赎回有条件恢复。
Access to the deposit could allow outstanding fiat redemptions to clear.
alternative: 银行转账通道仍可能堵塞，即使储备没有损失，用户也可能继续等待。
Banking rails could still delay payouts even if the reserve deposit was recoverable.
test: 找发行人按日期披露的赎回量和积压状态，同时保留各交易场所的 USDC 报价作为另一项观察。
Check dated issuer figures for redemptions and pending requests. Track venue-specific USDC quotes separately.
outcome: Circle 在 3 月 16 日的更新中称，截至 15 日银行收盘，积压请求已基本清理；自周一早晨起共赎回 38 亿、铸造 8 亿 USDC。
On March 16 Circle reported that most requests had cleared by the March 15 banking close. It reported 3.8bn USDC redeemed and 0.8bn minted since Monday morning.
lesson: 发行人能否兑付、银行多久结算、某个池子以什么价格成交，是三个可以分别检验的问题。
Track issuer backing, time to bank settlement and the executable price in a particular pool separately.

title: GHO 稳定模块还有多少兑换空间？
How much room was left in the GHO stability modules?

text: Chaos Labs 在 Aave 治理论坛建议 USDC、USDT 各设 500 万枚敞口上限。
Chaos Labs recommended exposure caps of 5m units each for USDC and USDT on the Aave governance forum.
建议的兑换比为 1:1，双向手续费均为零。这些数字属于初始配置建议。
The proposed starting terms used a 1:1 price ratio and zero fees in both directions. They were recommendations.

hypothesis: 只要模块在所需方向仍有容量，套利者就可能通过兑换缩小 GHO 的价格偏离。
If the module has room in the required direction, a swap could narrow a GHO price deviation.
alternative: 如果模块已收满对应抵押币，即使存在价差，同一方向的下一笔兑换仍受上限约束。
At the collateral exposure cap, another swap into the module in that direction can be constrained despite the price gap.
test: 查当时执行的上限、模块实际库存和交易方向；将论坛建议与生效参数逐项对照。
Compare the proposal with the effective cap, actual inventory and direction of the intended swap.
outcome: 2024 年 10 月，治理论坛记录两模块的上限均已变为 800 万枚，LlamaRisk 报告两者都已达到上限。同月关于迁移至 aUSDC 的提议仍处于征求意见阶段。
In October 2024 the forum documented caps of 8m units each. LlamaRisk reported both were full. The proposed migration to an aUSDC module was still under discussion.
lesson: 稳定币兑换容量有方向、额度和生效时间；固定兑换比只回答定价规则。
Store conversion direction, available headroom and the effective date alongside the advertised price ratio.

title: 以太坊开放提款，stETH 哪天才能赎回？
When could stETH holders request ETH back?

text: Lido 在 4 月 12 日的公告里把 Shapella 的目标时点列为当日约 22:27 UTC。
Lido’s April 12 notice put Shapella’s target at around 22:27 UTC that day.
同份公告把 Lido 自身的提款功能安排在 5 月，前提是完成测试和审计。
Lido gave a separate May estimate for its own withdrawal flow, conditional on testing and audits.

hypothesis: 共识层具备提款能力后，stETH 的直接赎回仍要等 Lido 启用自己的队列。
Validator withdrawals could be available while direct stETH redemptions still awaited Lido’s queue.
alternative: 持有人若从交易池卖出 stETH，也可能早已换回 ETH，但承担的是当时的池内成交价。
A holder could already exchange stETH in a secondary pool, subject to the execution price there.
test: 对照主网升级时间、Lido 开放申请的时间和具体申请的可领取状态。
Compare the network upgrade date, availability of Lido requests and claim status of the individual request.
outcome: 5 月 15 日，Lido 公布链上表决通过、V2 已在以太坊主网上线，用户可以通过协议直接申请退出。
On May 15 Lido confirmed the on-chain vote and the V2 mainnet launch, enabling direct unstaking requests through the protocol.
lesson: 把「允许提交申请」和「ETH 已到账」记为两个事件。判断某位持有人实际退出，仍需其申请及领取记录。
Record request acceptance and ETH receipt as separate events. A particular exit needs its own request and claim records.

title: 美国以太币现货基金何时真正开盘？
When did the US spot ether fund actually start trading?

text: 5 月 23 日，美国证监会第 34-100224 号令批准了交易所关于以太币 ETP 上市交易的规则变更。
On May 23 SEC order 34-100224 approved exchange rule changes for listing and trading ether-based ETP shares.

hypothesis: 审批让产品离上市更近，开盘仍需交易所或发行人给出具体产品及交易日期。
The order moved listing forward. An exchange or issuer announcement was still needed to establish a specific trading date.
alternative: 现货 ETH 在公告后产生的价格或成交变化，也可能来自预期交易，不能据此给基金记一笔申购。
Spot ETH trading around the decision could reflect anticipation. It supplies no fund creation record.
test: 将 SEC 订单号与基金代码、首个交易日对齐。若要判断资金流入，再查当日份额和净申购。
Match the SEC order to a fund ticker and first trading date. For inflows, check shares outstanding and net creations separately.
outcome: 7 月 23 日，贝莱德宣布 ETHA 在纳斯达克开始交易。开盘日期可核对，首日净申购金额仍需基金数据。
BlackRock announced ETHA began Nasdaq trading on July 23. That fixes the start date; first-day net creations require fund data.
lesson: 审批、首日成交和净申购分别入档，计算事件收益时先选清楚采用哪个时点。
Keep approval, first trade and net creations as separate timestamps when choosing an event window.

title: 新版验证器发布，Solana 已恢复了吗？
Did publishing a validator release mean Solana was back?

text: 2 月 6 日 11:36:44 UTC，Solana Labs 发布了面向主网的 v1.17.20。
Solana Labs published mainnet release v1.17.20 at 11:36:44 UTC on February 6.

hypothesis: 可下载的新版本只说明验证者有升级路径，共识恢复还要等集群实际推进。
The release gave validators a path to upgrade. Recovery still required the cluster to advance.
alternative: 即使某个 RPC 已能返回数据，也可能只是在返回暂停前的已确认状态。
A responding RPC might still be serving the last confirmed state from before the halt.
test: 核对恢复制块的槽位与共识时间；对用户订单另查最终确认的交易签名。
Check the restart slot and when consensus advanced. Verify a user order separately from its finalized signature.
outcome: Anza 的 2 月 9 日报告将最终确认停止记为 09:53 UTC，共识重新推进记为 14:55 UTC；重启采用的槽位为 246,464,040。
Anza’s February 9 report placed the finalization halt at 09:53 UTC and renewed consensus progress at 14:55 UTC. The restart slot was 246,464,040.
lesson: 客户端已发布、网络已推进、用户订单已确认要分开记录；一次重启不能替每笔订单确认成交。
Track software release, consensus recovery and order finalization independently. A cluster restart cannot settle an individual fill.

title: MATIC 换成 POL，哪条链需要迁移？
Which MATIC balances required migration to POL?

text: 7 月 18 日，Polygon 把 9 月 4 日列为预定升级日，计划让 POL 接替 Polygon PoS 的原生 gas 和质押代币。
Polygon’s July 18 plan targeted September 4 for POL to become the gas and staking token on Polygon PoS.
公告给持有 Polygon PoS 原生 MATIC 和持有以太坊 MATIC 的用户列了不同的迁移方式。
The notice gave different migration paths for native Polygon PoS balances and MATIC held on Ethereum.

hypothesis: 若按计划切换，Polygon PoS 的原生余额会自动延续，用 ETH 网络上的 MATIC 迁移则需要另一条操作记录。
If the migration proceeded as planned, native Polygon PoS balances would carry over. Ethereum MATIC conversions would follow a separate path.
alternative: 钱包缓存中的旧符号仍可能显示 MATIC；若只看代币名称，会把同一份原生余额重复计入。
A wallet could retain its old MATIC ticker. Counting token symbols alone could duplicate the same native balance.
test: 同时核对网络、原生或合约资产身份、迁移生效日期以及 1:1 兑换关系。
Verify network, native versus contract identity, effective date and the 1:1 conversion terms.
outcome: 9 月 4 日，Polygon 确认 PoS 主网已用 POL 支付 gas；对以太坊上的 MATIC，官方提供独立的 1:1 迁移入口。
On September 4 Polygon confirmed POL was live as the PoS gas token, with a separate 1:1 migration path for MATIC on Ethereum.
lesson: 跨迁移日的持仓和供应序列应保留前身、后继资产和链。符号切换本身不是买入、卖出或新增发行的证据。
Link predecessor and successor assets by chain when joining balances or supply across a migration. A ticker change alone supplies no trade or issuance evidence.

title: USDC 退出 TRON，交易所何时停充提？
When would an exchange close its TRON USDC rail?

text: 2 月 21 日刊载的 Circle 公告停止在 TRON 新铸造 USDC，并为 Circle Mint 客户保留到 2025 年 2 月的过渡期。
In its notice dated February 21 Circle stopped new USDC minting on TRON and described a transition through February 2025 for Circle Mint customers.

hypothesis: 交易所可能制定独立于发行人的充提截止日，所以要逐场所核对。
An exchange could impose its own transfer cutoff on a schedule distinct from the issuer’s.
alternative: 某条充提通道关闭后，同一交易所仍然可以支持其他网络的 USDC 充提，以及 USDC 现货交易。
An exchange could close one transfer rail while retaining USDC trading and transfers on other networks.
test: 检查交易所公告里的网络、业务类型和 UTC 截止时间，区分已公告的安排和某笔已入账的存款。
Match the exchange notice to a network, operation and UTC cutoff. A published schedule and an actual credited deposit are different evidence.
outcome: 3 月 25 日，币安公布将于 4 月 5 日 02:00 UTC 停止 TRC20 USDC 充提，继续支持 USDC 交易及其他受支持网络的充提。这是渠道安排的公告。
On March 25 Binance scheduled TRC20 USDC deposits and withdrawals to close at 02:00 UTC on April 5. It kept USDC trading and other supported networks in scope.
lesson: 稳定币身份、发行方支持、某条链的场所入账规则分别存储，才能判断某一笔转账能否到账。
Store token identity, issuer support and each venue’s network policy separately when evaluating a transfer route.

title: 减半首块的高收入持续了多久？
Did the halving block’s miner payout persist?

text: 区块 839,999 的 coinbase 输出合计 7.29455386 BTC；按该高度 6.25 BTC 的补贴计算，超出补贴 1.04455386 BTC。
Block 839,999 paid 7.29455386 BTC in coinbase outputs. With the 6.25 BTC subsidy at that height, the amount above subsidy was 1.04455386 BTC.
区块 840,000 的补贴降到 3.125 BTC，coinbase 却领取了 40.75061499 BTC，其中超出补贴的部分为 37.62561499 BTC。
Block 840,000 had a 3.125 BTC subsidy and 40.75061499 BTC in coinbase outputs, leaving 37.62561499 BTC above subsidy.

hypothesis: 若高额手续费持续，矿工每块领取的金额即使在减半后也可能保持较高水平。
Persistently high fees could sustain large block payouts after the subsidy cut.
alternative: 减半首块可能恰逢短时抢占区块空间；收入高点未必代表新的常态。
Competition for that particular block could have been temporary, making its payout a poor baseline.
test: 用各高度的 coinbase 输出总额减当期补贴。保留具体区块和单位，并把离散抽样与窗口均值分别统计。
Subtract the height-specific subsidy from coinbase outputs, keeping the block ID and units. Treat point samples and window averages separately.
outcome: Block 840,144 paid 4.40931185 BTC, 1.28431185 above subsidy. Block 841,008 paid 3.76968763 BTC, 0.64468763 above subsidy. Both later samples were well below the halving block.
lesson: 补贴是协议参数，手续费受区块空间需求影响。这四个样本能反驳每块都维持高点的说法，还不足以给出整周均值或任一矿工的利润。
Subsidy follows the protocol; fee revenue varies with block-space demand. These four samples falsify a sustained per-block peak, but do not estimate weekly averages or any miner’s profit.

title: CME 以太币期货的成交会交付 ETH 吗？
Did a CME ether futures trade deliver ETH?

text: 2020 年 12 月 16 日，CME 宣布拟在监管审查后于次年 2 月 8 日推出 Ether 期货。
On December 16, 2020 CME proposed a February 8 launch for ether futures, subject to regulatory review.
公告规定以美元现金结算，并以 CME CF 以太币兑美元参考汇率计价。
The announced contract specified cash settlement using the CME CF Ether-Dollar Reference Rate.

hypothesis: 新增的合约可以承载风险敞口和套保，期货到期结算本身不产生 ETH 链上交割。
The instrument could carry exposure or hedges. Cash settlement at expiry would not itself deliver on-chain ETH.
alternative: 做市商可能通过现货对冲，因此期货活动仍可能间接影响现货；仅凭合约成交量不能量出这种影响。
A market maker could hedge in spot markets. Futures volume alone cannot identify the size or direction of that hedge.
test: 先读结算条款，再按工具分别看期货持仓和现货交易；若声称买入 ETH，需要另有现货成交依据。
Read the settlement terms, then compare futures open interest and spot activity separately. A spot purchase needs its own execution evidence.
outcome: 2021 年 2 月 8 日，CME 确认合约已推出，并再次说明按美元参考汇率现金结算。
CME confirmed launch on February 8, 2021 and reiterated that the contract settled in cash against the dollar reference rate.
lesson: 把合约风险敞口、到期结算义务和可能的现货对冲分开；不同市场的名义成交量不能相加当作链上买盘。
Keep contract exposure, settlement obligations and any documented spot hedge distinct when comparing volumes across markets.

title: OP Mainnet 的证明权限会变吗？
Could the proof permissions on OP Mainnet change?

text: 6 月 10 日，Optimism 宣布 OP Mainnet 已开放无许可故障证明。
On June 10 Optimism announced permissionless fault proofs were live on OP Mainnet.
同一公告披露，安全委员会保留干预权限，可让证明系统回到许可模式。
The same notice documented the Security Council’s ability to intervene and return the proof system to a permissioned mode.

hypothesis: 评估某个时点的提现信任条件时，需要检查当时启用的证明模式。
Withdrawal trust assumptions at a given time depend on the proof mode actually enabled then.
alternative: 仅按上线日期给网络永久标记「无许可」，会漏掉治理切换模式的时间段。
A permanent permissionless label dated only to launch could conceal periods when governance changed the active mode.
test: 将提现窗口对齐上线、回退与恢复记录；具体提现另看自己的证明和最终结算状态。
Align the withdrawal window with activation, fallback and restoration records. Confirm the individual withdrawal’s proof and settlement separately.
outcome: 8 月 21 日，OP Labs 工程师确认已启用许可回退。9 月 12 日的治理周报记载 Granite 于前一日实施，无许可证明已恢复。

An OP Labs engineer confirmed the permissioned fallback had been activated on August 21’s forum thread. The September 12 governance bulletin reported that Granite went live the previous day and restored permissionless proofs.
lesson: 将证明模式和生效区间一起存储。网络名称、当前设置、特定历史提现所依赖的权限，各自回答不同问题。
Version proof modes by their period of effect. A historical withdrawal should inherit the permissions of its own window.

title: Blob 容量翻倍，L2 成本也跟着减半吗？
Did doubling the blob target halve rollup costs?

text: Pectra 公告列出的原参数为每块目标 3 个 Blob、最多 6 个；拟将目标增为 6、上限增为 9。
The Pectra announcement listed a target of three blobs and maximum of six per block, with planned increases to six and nine, respectively.
主网激活预定在 epoch 364,032，即 5 月 7 日 10:05:11 UTC。
The Foundation scheduled mainnet activation for epoch 364,032, at 10:05:11 UTC on May 7.

hypothesis: 若需求变化不大，更多数据空间可能减轻 Rollup 提交数据的费用压力。
With comparable demand, additional data space could ease fee pressure on rollup batch submissions.
alternative: 更多需求可以吸收新增容量；用户手续费还会受到 L2 自身执行成本与收费规则影响。
Additional demand could use the new capacity. End-user fees also depend on L2 execution costs and fee policies.
test: 先核对生效的目标值，再取使用量、Blob 基础费和指定 L2 同类交易的实付费用，按同一时窗比较。
Verify the effective target, then compare blob use, blob base fee and user-paid fees for like transactions on the same L2 and time window.
outcome: 11 月 6 日，以太坊基金会在下一轮升级公告中将当时的主网目标和上限列为 6 和 9。该记录能确认容量基线，未给出任一 Rollup 的用户手续费降幅。

On November 6 the Foundation described six and nine as the current mainnet target and maximum. This establishes the capacity baseline; the notice provides no realized fee reduction for a particular rollup.
lesson: 网络能容纳多少、实际用了多少、用户实际支付多少要分项比较；只有第一项翻倍无法量出后两项。
Compare physical capacity, utilization and the user’s paid fee independently.
